limitations: A deployment universe is venue evidence at `evidence_at`, not a timeless fact. An instrument that becomes fractionable, or stops being so, makes this fingerprint stale.
Exclusion here is an execution-capability statement and never a research judgement. A company excluded as WHOLE_SHARE_ONLY may be fully Compounder-eligible, and its score is unaffected.
No value here was derived from returns. Fractionability was read from provider metadata and nothing was selected for performance.
